record.reason: The paper's method, system design and reported result are about pretraining: Pseudo-to-Real cross-layer sharing/delinking and CPU offloading enable a 10-trillion-parameter model to be pretrained on 512 GPUs over 10 days. It does not evaluate inference-time efficiency, inference serving or decoding. Training efficiency is outside the requested inference-focused scope.
record.title: M6-10T: A Sharing-Delinking Paradigm for Efficient Multi-Trillion Parameter Pretraining
